name: Laws of the Hunt

sources: Mind's Eye Theatre: Laws of the Hunt (WW05014), "Weapon Examples"/Armor chapter, pp.259-263 - every entry checked against the accumulated catalog so far (Dark Epics, Laws of the Night Revised Edition); a same-name entry whose stats match an already-catalogued one, from either book, is left out of this file.

Every entry read directly from the book's own page images (not OCR), per reference-wod-scan-ocr-lessons. This copy's own printed page numbers are plain, legible Arabic numerals - no citation uncertainty here, unlike Laws of the Night Revised Edition's own stylized folio font.

notes: Of this chapter's 15 printed weapon/armor entries, 13 are real duplicates of an already-catalogued entry (Knife/Dagger, Pistol, Heavy Pistol, Chain mail, Plate mail match Dark Epics; Wooden Stake, Club, Ax, Fencing Blades, Longbow, Rifle, Shotgun, Ballistic Vest, Reinforced (Bulletproof) Vest match Laws of the Night Revised Edition) and correctly left out - only Broadsword and Shuriken/Dart carry a real divergence worth its own entry.

Submachine Gun's own availability text here reads "semi-automatic" where Dark Epics prints "non-automatic" for the identical legal requirement - read as the same constraint in different words, not a different rule, and left out as a duplicate rather than kept for that wording alone.

Longbow's own text here adds a real combat nuance (retesting needs the Athletics Ability; without it a character gets only a third of the usual Bonus Traits) that neither this catalog's `properties` schema nor Laws of the Night Revised Edition's own entry captures - a general rule about how the Athletics Ability interacts with bows, not a property of this one printing, so it stays uncaptured here the same way a book's own surrounding rules text always does.

items.name: Broadsword

availability.name: Broadswords typically must be special-ordered, although cheap and not especially durable versions are sometimes available at military-supply stores or Renaissance festivals

items.description: Covers every blade of medium length, from western broadswords to scimitars - except the katana, filed under Fencing Blades instead.

items.name: Shuriken/Dart
items.description: Negative Trait Clumsy: shuriken and darts are notoriously inaccurate beyond short range. Spray requires at least one level of Athletics, hitting up to three targets within a pace of each other and within 20 feet of the thrower.
